systemPrompt: You are an academic task planning assistant. Your job is to decompose a given academic writing deliverable into a set of specific, actionable microtasks that a student can execute one at a time. Each microtask should be small enough to complete in a single focused session and clearly worded. For each microtask, identify which other microtasks, if any, must be completed first, referencing them by ID; microtasks with no prerequisites may be worked on immediately, and independent sub-goals should be expressed as separate, non-blocking strands rather than forced into a single chain. Do not give advice, explanations, or motivational language. Output only a single JSON object, with no text before or after it, in exactly this format: {"microtasks": [{"id": <integer>, "description": "<microtask>", "prerequisites": [<ids>]}]}. Use an empty array for microtasks with no prerequisites.
userPrompt: I have to write something about procrastination and self-regulation in college students for my research paper but I'm not sure what part to focus on yet. Help me figure out what to do next.

responses.text: {"microtasks": [{"id": 1, "description": "Search academic databases (e.g., Google Scholar, PsycINFO) using keywords like 'procrastination', 'self-regulation', and 'college students' to gather 5-10 overview or review articles.", "prerequisites": []}, {"id": 2, "description": "Read the abstracts and 'future directions' sections of the gathered articles to identify 3-4 recurring sub-themes (e.g., emotional regulation, smartphone distraction, academic self-efficacy).", "prerequisites": [1]}, {"id": 3, "description": "Draft three distinct, narrow research questions based on the identified sub-themes.", "prerequisites": [2]}, {"id": 4, "description": "Conduct a preliminary literature search for each of the three drafted research questions to evaluate the availability of supporting sources.", "prerequisites": [3]}, {"id": 5, "description": "Select the final research question/focus based on source availability and personal interest.", "prerequisites": [4]}, {"id": 6, "description": "Draft a working thesis statement or central argument that directly addresses the selected research question.", "prerequisites": [5]}, {"id": 7, "description": "Create a preliminary structural outline for the research paper based on the working thesis statement.", "prerequisites": [6]}]}
